title: Verification evidence reuse decision
outOfScope: Changes to scripts/ai_verification_context.py, scripts/ai_verify.py, verification cache behavior, skipped required checks, provider operations, release, tags, impact routing, scheduler/retry behavior, and any reuse claim without fully matching bindings.

sources.reason: Task 8 permits a source-backed no-change decision.
Current verification inputs do not bind reusable receipt identity.
Current verification runner always executes declared stages.

riskAssessment.reason: An unsafely reused receipt could suppress a required verification check after source, environment, or policy changes.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: A bounded, evidence-based no-change decision is defined by the Task 8 plan.

preReviewWarnings: Review that the decision makes no reuse eligibility or skipped-check claim.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Task 7 timing and current receipt/context sources are analyzed and recorded with an explicit decision.
No content-addressed receipt is added and ai_verify retains normal execution for every required check.
The decision document enumerates base commit, head commit, changed-paths, command, environment, toolchain, and policy bindings required for any future reuse.
Focused verification-evidence tests, required governance checks, archive, PR, merge, and ai-close-work-item have recorded evidence.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Task 7 demonstrates material local verification cost but supplies no comparable, content-addressed repeated receipts that could safely prove reuse eligibility.
constraints: No required check may be skipped for this Work Item.
Any future reuse requires identical base/head commits, changed paths, command, environment, toolchain, and policy digests.
One local or hosted timing sample is characterization evidence, not a reuse policy.
The recorded user approval is limited to this Work Item PR, merge, and governed cleanup.
intent.rationale: A source-backed no-change decision preserves verification integrity until receipt validity can be proven instead of inferred.
